messages:
cleo: Quick PSA for onboarding: our quickstart sample shows PREFETCH=3 and no smoothing, which makes new users hit 429s if their token provider rotates frequently. Repro'd on node quickstart.

jasper: Hmm that's bad. Can you paste repro steps and a tiny log snippet?

cleo: Repro steps:
1) start quickstart: ./quickstart --concurrency=8 --page-size=1
2) run a token rotator: while sleep 1.5; do ./swap-local-token; done
3) run a client that iterates pages with prefetch=3

cleo: Minimal logs:
[2026-05-10T12:01:02Z] INFO paginator fetch cursor=5 attempt=1
[2026-05-10T12:01:03Z] WARN auth refresh acct=team-x
[2026-05-10T12:01:03Z] ERROR http 401 -> retry
[2026-05-10T12:01:03Z] INFO paginator fetch cursor=5 attempt=2
[2026-05-10T12:01:03Z] INFO paginator fetch cursor=6 attempt=1
[2026-05-10T12:01:04Z] ERROR http 429 rate_limit

aditya: Sounds like two stacked problems: (A) prefetch multiplies in-flight requests, (B) retry-after-auth spawns new requests rather than reusing the inflight promise. Node sdk had a middleware refactor that regressed dedupe.

nora: Also check client-side window semantics. If the SDK resets the local token bucket on auth refresh, prefetch suddenly has quota to burn and you get a microburst. Py currently preserves remainder; node resets by default.

jasper: Agreed. Short-term mitigation for quickstart: lower PREFETCH to 1 and enable smoothing + refresh jitter. Sample env snippet we should ship:
```json
{
  "PREFETCH": "1",
  "CONCURRENCY": "4",
  "CLIENT_SMOOTHING": "true",
  "REFRESH_JITTER_MS": "200",
  "ENABLE_RETRY_DEDUPE": "true"
}
```

cleo: I tested that locally, and 429 spikes disappear with those flags.

aditya: Long-term fixes we discussed:
- node-sdk: attach retry to inflight cursor promises (inflightMap[cursor] -> promise)
- SDK default: preserve_window_on_refresh = true (safer for onboarding)
- SDKs: add adaptive_prefetch that reduces prefetch when remaining tokens low
- samples: change quickstart README snippet to prefetch=1 and include note about tradeoffs

jasper: I'll open a PR to samples to change quickstart defaults + add a small reproducer harness that CI can run to catch regressions. Also will add a small table in SDK parity docs describing default behaviors per language (node/py/go).

ci-bot: Created issue #4621: "quickstart: prefetch + token rotations -> onboarding 429s" (https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/issues/4621)

cleo: One doc ask: add a short "Troubleshooting onboarding 429s" section to the devex guide with the sample env above, explanation of prefetch, and link to the issue. New users keep opening support tickets thinking the API is flaky.

aditya: Will draft the doc blurb and propose default SDK config changes. If we default to preserve_window_on_refresh and enable retry dedupe, most of these noisy tickets should vanish.

jasper: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/921 (quickstart safer defaults + reproducer). please review.

cleo: Verified PR locally  no 429s in my reproducer. thanks team. closing thread; followups in GH. :thumbsup:
